name: ppGpp riboswitch bound to guanosine tetraphosphate
source: RCSB PDB 6DMC; Sherwood AV et al. Mol Cell 2018 doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2018.06.049
notes: RSH-associated RNA (RSAR) ppGpp riboswitch from Enterococcus faecalis. Ligand G4P (ppGpp = guanosine-3-diphosphate-5-diphosphate, 4 phosphates, MW=603). 2.20A X-ray. Novel class.
affinitySource: Sherwood AV et al. 2018; Kd ~100 nM for ppGpp
affinityNotes: ppGpp riboswitch (RSAR). ppGpp has 4 phosphate groups — largest ligand-P contribution expected. Novel class, not in any prior RNA docking benchmark.
